/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sqlite3

names = ['release.md', 'readers.py', '001_schema.sql', '002_up.sql', '003_new_writes.sql', '002_down.sql']
before = {n: hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in names}
readers = runpy.run_path('readers.py')
queries = {n: readers[n] for n in ('OLD', 'NEW')}
labels = {'OLD': ['id', 'label', 'payload'], 'NEW': ['id', 'title', 'payload']}
initial = [(1, '첫 항목', bytes.fromhex('00ff')), (2, 'keep', b'')]
written = [(1, 'updated', bytes.fromhex('fe00')), (2, 'keep', b''), (3, 'new', bytes.fromhex('80'))]
phases = [
    ('1 schema', '001_schema.sql', {'OLD'}, initial),
    ('2 upgrade', '002_up.sql', {'OLD'}, initial),
    ('3 writes/coexistence', '003_new_writes.sql', {'OLD', 'NEW'}, written),
    ('4 drain NEW/restart OLD', None, {'OLD'}, written),
    ('5 rollback', '002_down.sql', {'OLD'}, written),
]
expected_statuses = [
    ('compatible', 'inactive error'),
    ('ACTIVE INCOMPATIBILITY', 'compatible (inactive)'),
    ('ACTIVE INCOMPATIBILITY', 'compatible'),
    ('ACTIVE INCOMPATIBILITY', 'compatible (inactive)'),
    ('compatible', 'inactive error'),
]
print('Python sqlite3 SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('One connection: sqlite3.connect(\":memory:\")')
print('Literal queries:', queries)
print('Expected ordered labels:', labels)
print('Expected initial rows:', repr(initial))
print('Expected committed-write rows (phases 3-5):', repr(written))
con = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
try:
    for index, (phase, script, active, expected_rows) in enumerate(phases):
        print('\\nCHECKPOINT', phase, '| active:', ', '.join(sorted(active)))
        if script:
            con.executescript(Path(script).read_text())
            con.commit()
            print('Executed supplied script unchanged:', script, '| in_transaction:', con.in_transaction)
        else:
            print('No schema or data changes; reader activity only.')
        statuses = []
        for name, query in queries.items():
            try:
                cursor = con.execute(query)
                actual_labels = [d[0] for d in cursor.description]
                actual_rows = cursor.fetchall()
            except sqlite3.Error as exc:
                status = 'ACTIVE ERROR' if name in active else 'inactive error'
                print(name, status, '|', type(exc).__name__ + ':', str(exc))
                assert name == 'NEW' and index in (0, 4)
                assert str(exc) == 'no such column: title'
            else:
                label_ok = actual_labels == labels[name]
                rows_ok = actual_rows == expected_rows
                types_ok = all(tuple(type(value) for value in row) == (int, str, bytes) for row in actual_rows)
                compatible = label_ok and rows_ok and types_ok
                status = ('compatible' if name in active else 'compatible (inactive)') if compatible else ('ACTIVE INCOMPATIBILITY' if name in active else 'inactive incompatibility')
                print(name, status)
                print('  observed labels:', actual_labels, '| labels_match:', label_ok)
                print('  observed complete rows:', repr(actual_rows), '| rows_match:', rows_ok, '| types_match:', types_ok)
                print('  BLOB hex by id:', [(row[0], row[2].hex()) for row in actual_rows])
                assert rows_ok and types_ok
                assert label_ok == (name == 'NEW' or index in (0, 4))
            statuses.append(status)
        assert tuple(statuses) == expected_statuses[index], (phase, statuses)
        base = con.execute('SELECT id, title, payload FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
        assert base == expected_rows
        print('Base-table complete rows:', repr(base), '| write-state contract: PASS')
    assert con.execute(queries['OLD']).fetchall() == written
    print('\\nPASS: all ten literal-query outcomes checked; committed updates and insert survive rollback.')
finally:
    con.close()
after = {n: hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in names}
assert before == after
print('PASS: SHA-256 of all six supplied files unchanged; no scratch files created.')
PY"
